items.heading: Most "Best Courses After 12th"
items.text: Most "best courses after 12th" lists mix diplomas, degrees, and vague career paths into one grid, which makes the comparison meaningless. This page sticks to one lane: full-length degree courses, compared like-for-like on duration, fee range, entry exam, and realistic salary.
